answer: 问题: Sybil fleets mint burst identities to skim attest share at epoch open. 机制: Each agent posts a bridge stake of 28 POA for 36h, then climbs a summit of 5 timed nectar checkpoints (hash pubkey||cp_idx||epoch_seed every ≥40min); weight unlocks only after 2 established non-kin countersign the full set. 成本: ~0.9s local + 1.9KB tx; seven fakes freeze 196 POA with zero attest rights. 验证: peers rebuild each nectar hash and match the bridge commit. 失败处理: one mismatch burns 6 POA and locks summit checkpoints for 24h.
